programs.name: west_court_bar
programs.rationale: Linear slab-derived bar with a west-facing court and entry seam; compact active ground edge with calm lifted upper mass.

programs.name: bent_entry_bar
programs.rationale: Curved bar with terraced upper retreat and west notch; continuous street edge with a readable public seam.

programs.name: split_court_bridge
programs.rationale: Split-wing block with a physical bridge and central court, preserving a west-facing public void and an active ground spine.

programs.name: stepped_market_edge
programs.rationale: Low stepped market plinth with a carved west court and entry notch; sectional variety carries the public ground edge.

programs.name: chamfered_corner_wedge
programs.rationale: Chamfered corner block with a west-facing public void and entry seam; oblique cut family distinct from barred and courted options.

programs.name: bridge_podium
programs.rationale: Lifted podium-bar with an upper bridge and west threshold cut; emphasizes overlap and active ground rather than a single compact block.

programs.name: courted_office_stack
programs.rationale: Stacked block with terraced upper retreat and a west-facing courtyard; a different sectional family centered on shared open space.

programs.name: porous_pavilion
programs.rationale: Low pavilion with porous base punctures and a west-facing threshold court; materially distinct as a horizontal permeable family.
